title: Fire Force
titleNative: 炎炎ノ消防隊
synopsis: Terror has paralyzed the clockwork metropolis of Tokyo! Possessed by demons, people have begun to burst into flame, leading to the establishment of a special firefighting team: the Fire Force, ready to roll on a moment's notice to fight spontaneous combustion anywhere it might break out. The team is about to get a very unique addition: Shinra, a boy who possesses the unique power to run at the speed of a rocket, leaving behind the famous "devil's footprints" (and destroying his shoes in the process). Can the Fire Force discover the source of this strange phenomenon and put a stop to it? Or will the city burn to ashes first? (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: World End Economica
titleNative: WORLD END ECONOMiCA
synopsis: Roughly 16 years after the people who emigrated to the Moon had settled themselves. An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A young boy named Hal, born and raised on the Moon, is one of those people chasing his wildest dream. His dream, is to stand where no man has before. In order to do so, he needed capital. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. There are only two key rules that govern that land. "The first rule, is to never take a loss. The second rule, is to never forget the first." Only those who followed these rules were able to obtain enormous wealth. The stock market. A place that has gathered crowds of persistent men and women for centuries. (Source: WEE Official)

title: How to Love a Loser
titleNative: ダメ人間の愛しかた
synopsis: Shinba has no talent, no job, no money...he's a complete loser. However, he has a girlfriend, Hizumi who is beautiful, smart, good at her work. He has no idea why she says she likes him. He's almost scared, but loves Hizumi so much...he asks Hizumi, "Why do you want to date with someone like me?" She answers..."You always oversleep, talk about some video games I don't even know about, sing lame songs no one knows at karaoke, gave me a toy ring as a gift. Your face is always gloomy as hell. But...looking at such face makes me happy, Shinba. I love you, ha ha." Is she telling the truth? Hizumi must have some kind of a secret, Shinba thinks. He wants to find out...but maybe he shouldn't. (Source: BookWalker)

title: Gate: Where the JSDF Fought
titleRomaji: Gate: Jieitai Kanochi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri
titleNative: ゲート―自衛隊彼の地にて、斯く戦えり
synonyms: Gate: Thus the JSDF Fought There
เกท - หน่วยรบตะลุยโลกต่างมิติ
synopsis: One day in the 21st century, a gate opened in the middle of the Ginza district of Tokyo. Out of the gate poured soldiers and strange creatures, and they soon made Ginza look like an image of hell. The gate apparently connected Japan to another world, a world with a militant empire and many supernatural creatures. The Japanese Self-Defense Force decided to send a small group, led by a soldier who's also an otaku, into the other world on a reconnaissance mission. They're meant to learn what they can about the empire (and its plans), the world, and the people. They're hardly in the world yet, though, when they come across a village destroyed by a giant fire-breathing dragon. The only survivor is an unconscious elven girl they find hidden in a well. Now they feel like they must warn the nearby towns about the dragon, and do what they can to help. On the way, they'll meet more magical, female companions, and learn more about this dangerous new world.

synopsis: Set in the Heian era, when the Fujiwara clan schemed to seize power at the Imperial Court, a court lady's mysterious disappearance suddenly occurs in the capital. Tasked by the Emperor, who fears it may be the work of the oni, Ariwara no Narihira encounters a young man named Sugawara no Michizane. This unlikely pair - the reclusive student Michizane and the famously charming Narihira, separated by class, birth, and nearly 20 years in age - team up to unravel the bizarre cases in Kyoto! From the rising talent Yak Haibara of "Kaiyu no mori"(Walks in the Woods) and "SP"(Security Police) comes a Heian-period crime suspense manga! (Source: Emaqi)
